incident_context.environment: Primary data-center network, scheduled change window
incident_context.service_impact: Application workers in the payments segment lost database connectivity; customer-facing ingress remained available.

attempted_change.change_summary: Narrow database access to the payments application tier while updating distributed ACLs.

operations.rule_description: Permit application workers to reach the database service on TCP port 5432.
Remove the prior broad database access rule after the scoped rule is installed.

observed_anomalies.threshold: Alert when failures exceed 5% for 2 consecutive minutes

observed_anomalies.observed_value: Ingress updated on all nodes; egress update timed out on 4 of 12 nodes
observed_anomalies.threshold: All nodes must acknowledge the same policy revision within 90 seconds

post_failure_snapshot.observed_policy_state: Policy revision 1842 is present on ingress nodes; egress nodes retain revision 1841. The prior broad rule has not been removed.

risk_assessment.risk_rationale: Database probes exceed the stated failure threshold, and policy revisions are inconsistent across nodes. The affected application-to-database path is impaired, while the old rule remains in place; further rollout could deepen the inconsistency.

recovery_actions.action: Stop the remaining rollout and disable automatic retries for this change set.
recovery_actions.target: Policy deployment for payments-app and payments-db
recovery_actions.expected_effect: No additional nodes receive a partial revision while recovery proceeds.

recovery_actions.action: Restore the recorded pre-change policy revision across the affected nodes.
recovery_actions.target: Ingress and egress ACLs for payments-app and payments-db
recovery_actions.expected_effect: All nodes return to a consistent policy state and the previously available database path is restored.

recovery_actions.action: Run database-path probes after policy convergence.
recovery_actions.expected_effect: Confirm that application connectivity has recovered before proposing another change.

replacement_plan.plan_summary: Replace the fleet-wide combined update with a staged rollout that first validates the scoped rule on a canary node, then expands only after policy convergence and application probes pass.

plan_steps.operation: Validate the proposed scoped TCP 5432 rule against the current payments database policy and confirm the legacy rule remains unchanged during this stage.
plan_steps.preconditions: The pre-change policy revision is consistent on all nodes, database health probes are stable, and the change has an approved maintenance window.
plan_steps.validation_gate: Policy review confirms the source, destination, and port scope; baseline application probes pass before any deployment.

plan_steps.operation: Apply the scoped rule to one canary node without removing the legacy rule.
plan_steps.preconditions: Step 1 passes and the canary node reports the expected pre-change revision.
plan_steps.validation_gate: The canary acknowledges the new revision and payments-app database probes pass for 5 minutes; otherwise stop and restore the canary.

plan_steps.operation: Roll out the scoped rule in small batches, then remove the legacy rule only after all nodes converge.
plan_steps.preconditions: Canary validation passes and each rollout batch has an explicit stop-and-restore procedure.
plan_steps.validation_gate: Every batch reports a consistent revision and passing database probes before the next batch or legacy-rule removal.

safety_constraints: Keep the legacy rule until the scoped replacement is confirmed across all nodes.
Do not continue a rollout while policy revisions differ between nodes.
Stop and restore the last known consistent revision if database probe failures exceed 5% for 2 consecutive minutes.

recovery_decision.rationale: The change did not converge and has already disrupted a critical application path. Restoring the last known consistent policy revision is safer than attempting another in-place update across a mixed state.
selected_change_actions: Remove the newly added scoped TCP 5432 allow rule from the payments-app to payments-db policy.
Restore the pre-change policy revision on all nodes and retain the legacy rule until a replacement is validated.

trajectory_summary: A partially converged ACL update caused database probe failures, so the agent halted retries and fully restored the last consistent policy revision. Post-recovery checks confirmed connectivity and policy consistency. The replacement plan introduces a canary and gated batches, delaying removal of the legacy rule until the scoped rule is validated.

checks.evidence: All 12 nodes report the same pre-change revision; no node reports the interrupted revision.
Failure rate remained below 1% across 5 minutes of post-rollback probes, below the 5% alert threshold.
Ingress health checks remained available throughout recovery.

residual_risks: The legacy broad database rule remains active pending a separately reviewed replacement change.
